item.title: CPS approves calendars for next 2 school years with longer summer break
item.description: <p>The Chicago Board of Education on Thursday approved the academic calendars for the next two school years without adjusting the end of an academic quarter so it ends before winter break, as some board members had suggested considering.</p><p>The first day of school next fall is set for Aug. 24, and the last day will be on June 11, 2027. item.title: Margaret Bonds, an influential Chicago composer, gets a gravestone, at last
item.description: <p>Composer and pianist Margaret Bonds was a trailblazer. In 1933, she became the first Black musician to solo with the Chicago Symphony.
